g.title: r20
g.text: Crystal and flask open east door

g.title: legend
g.text: Numbers identify BASIC rooms. Letters beside a room
are commands to leave it. Lines show routes, not sightlines.
Grey: ordinary two-way route. Gold: conditional passage.
Teal: rope / level change. Rose: one-way bat transport.
GALAR: from any safe room, teleport to entrance 16;
clued in courtyard 50. Shown here rather than 53 extra arrows.
Only crater 7 west retains a warned fatal compass exit.
At home: treasures bank automatically; score / ranking shown.
You may continue exploring or QUIT.
